semantics.reachability: Breadth-first search over the explicit finite transition relation from initial_state; output is true exactly when target_state is reachable.
semantics.invariant: Breadth-first search over the explicit finite transition relation from initial_state; output is true exactly when every reachable state satisfies the invariant predicate.
semantics.trace_equivalence: Enumerate all action-label traces up to max_depth from each initial state; output is true exactly when the two trace-language sets are equal.

upgrade_policy.patch: fix logs or docs only - does not affect scores
upgrade_policy.minor: add new counterexamples or properties - old scores preserved, new scores computed separately
upgrade_policy.major: semantic definition change - old and new leaderboards cannot be directly compared
